news.title: 5 facts about religion in the Philippines
news.summary_en: Nearly all Filipinos believe in God, most pray daily and 92% identify as Christian, with Catholics as the majority.

news.title: Which Americans are most likely to have spoken with a local journalist?
news.summary_en: About a quarter of Americans have spoken with a local journalist, with education, income, race and community attachment linked to higher rates of interaction.
